protected_patterns.message: Use update-loop-state.sh to update state fields. Do NOT edit this file directly.
AGENTS.md is a symlink to CLAUDE.md. Use update-loop-state.sh to update state fields. Do NOT edit this file directly.
The results TSV is the canonical tree store, written ONLY by tree.sh (create/insert). Use tree.sh to record experiments — do not edit directly.
Goal state files are script-owned: {slug}.state by update-loop-state.sh, {slug}.base by tree.sh base/insert. Do not edit directly.
prepare.py defines the frozen time budget and evaluation harness for this goal. It is read-only.
Dependencies are frozen for this goal; experiments may only modify train.py.
